title: gate add --do accepts an option whose text holds '=', such as a tests-ceiling answer
goal: Found at the SP-m3azo2y7 close: gate add on BG-b5vvixda refused --do 'tests-ceiling ids=100 ...=BG-b5vvixda' with 'OPTION one of the --option values', because --do splits OPTION=CMD at the first '=' and the tests-ceiling answer form holds several; the gate was filed without its do entries. --do splits at the '=' after the longest --option value it starts with (or at the last '='), so every option of the documented answer forms can name its item.

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
live = os.getcwd(); t = tempfile.mkdtemp(); subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', t], check=True)
os.makedirs(t + '/kb/_self/backlog')
b = [sys.executable, live + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', t]

i, j = new(), new()
r1 = run('gate', 'add', i, '--question', 'q', '--option', 'x ids=1', '--option', 'y', '--recommendation', 'x ids=1', '--do', 'x ids=1=' + i)

print(r1.stdout, r1.stderr, r2.stdout, r2.stderr)
sys.exit(r1.returncode or r2.returncode)
